claim: Parametric resonance § and Strutt diagram §: below a threshold q the pumped resonator settles; above it the noise floor 'cracks' into exponentially growing oscillation, and the tongue boundary is exactly where a characteristic multiplier crosses the unit circle. The text names twenty media items (media-01..20) and embeds none of them.

pieces.what: media-06 explorer: click/drag across a tongue edge and hear silence crack into ringing; tests that the stable/unstable boundary is audible, not just drawn
pieces.walks_up_from: a plain undamped oscillator at q = 0, one ring

pieces.what: media-04 triple (q = 0.05 / 0.10 / 0.30, same noise seed) beside media-20's 30 s q sweep; tests the threshold claim by ear
pieces.walks_up_from: driving vs pumping: the right-hand side stays zero

pieces.what: media-09: drag (a,q) and watch one multiplier leave the unit circle as the sound crosses the edge; tests 'the tongue boundary is the unit circle'
pieces.walks_up_from: one period of the monodromy: where a state lands after T

pieces.section: Sidebands — where the ladder comes from
pieces.what: media-12 figure with the media-13 quartet (cosine/FM/square/wavetable pump on 220 Hz); tests 'the modulation's Fourier series is the spectral envelope'
pieces.walks_up_from: ring modulation as the simplest Floquet system
